enterprise.title: Upgrade to start using the Private API Network
enterprise.description: With the Private API Network, teams can always access available elements, organize them into folders and make them easy to discover and use.

solution.title: Hey, what's this? It’s the Private API Network!
solution.description: With the Private API Network, teams can always access available elements, organize them into folders and make them easy to discover and use. Private Network can be accessed once you purchase Postman’s Internal API Management solution.

ask_admin.title: Hey, what's this? It’s the Private API Network!
ask_admin.description: With the Private API Network, teams can access and organize elements into folders and make their discovery easy. Request an admin to purchase Postman’s Internal API Management solution to access Private API Network.

no_access.title: You don't have access
no_access.description: You do not have permission to view this Private API Network setting

not_enough_permission.title: You don’t have permission to view these settings
not_enough_permission.description: Only members with Network Manager, or Super Admin role can view and edit these settings.

enabled.title: Approval process is enabled
enabled.subtext: API Network Managers and folder managers can review and approve elements to be added to the network.

disabled.title: Approval process is disabled
disabled.subtext: API Network Managers and folder managers can review and approve elements to be added to the network.

settings.tooltip: Approval process is no longer optional. Assign folder managers to delegate work.

approval_process_warning_modal.para1: Once enabled, this cannot be changed.
approval_process_warning_modal.para2: As a quality measure, the approval process is now recommended for teams that use the Private API Network.
approval_process_warning_modal.para3: The approval process ensures that only specific team members can approve or add elements to your Private API Network.
